title: Numbering marker without a hanging area: the tab runs to the next default 720-twip stop from the text-column edge, the 0 stop included
source: probe (PR #1408): level left=1032 hanging=360 in cells and body, compat 15, measured at 96 dpi: paragraph left=720 firstLine=0 puts the marker at 720 and the text at the next default stop; a marker ending before the edge tabs to 0

cases.note: paragraph firstLine=0 replaces the level hanging: marker at 720, not 360
level alone: marker at left - hanging
marker 720-880 with the text indent at 720: tab to the 1440 default stop (box 720 wide)
marker ending before the column edge tabs to the 0 stop
marker inside the hanging area: text at the hanging indent
w:defaultTabStop 0: the text follows the marker directly
